notes.title: Unlighted v.1.2.0 - Day 30 Update
notes.notes:
[p]Unlighted's 30th day update is here! This update improved the overall game performance, fixed several minor bugs and enabled controller support ;) 

General update listing:
[/p][list][*][p] Removed some Memory Leaks that were slowing down the game performance.
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved camera settings to maintain quality and improve performance.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added several light guides and visual elements to improve the UX after appearing in certain places in the final path of the Umbral world. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed multiple minor gameplay bugs.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed multiple minor UI bugs.
[/p][/*][*][p] Compatibility with controllers!
[/p][/*][/list]
